name: Shanhe Lü Tan
source:
"Murders on Yangtze River" is an Ace Attorney-like detective game that takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases. Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1746030/__Murders_on_the_Yangtze_River/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《长江凶杀案》是一款类似逆转裁判的侦探游戏，带你穿越20世纪初的中国，侦破一系列扣人心弦的案件。运用你的逻辑推理和推理能力来发现线索、审问嫌疑人并解开谜团。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1746030/__Murders_on_the_Yangtze_River/]Steam[/url]]
